stories.previous_coverage: Recent episodes covered Iran-war and oil-risk context but not this Riyadh airport attack or the U.S. decision point.

stories.why_now: The investigation was reported October 11 and the court reprieve runs until Tuesday.
stories.previous_coverage: No similar press-pool or DOJ antitrust-access segment in the previous seven scripts.

stories.date_exception: Quiet Sunday lending beat; October 8 HUD update is within seven days, explicitly dated, and changes a current FHA implementation plan for lenders preparing January 1 case numbers.
stories.new_fact: HUD said Mortgagee Letter 2026-11 formalized VantageScore 4.0 and FICO Score 10T as acceptable FHA score models for Title II case numbers assigned on or after January 1, 2027.
stories.new_takeaway: The operating task is MDCS and TOTAL integration, not another rate recap or broad credit-access promise.
stories.why_now: The update was published October 8 and preparation is current because January system mapping is near-term.
stories.previous_coverage: Prior episodes covered MBA credit availability, Fannie LLPA alignment and possible bi-merge credit reporting; FHA MDCS implementation has not led.
stories.uncertainty: Lender overlays, credit-vendor readiness and TOTAL Scorecard 5.0 details still need confirmation.
stories.watch: TOTAL Scorecard 5.0 release, FHA office-hours clarifications, vendor notices or lender overlays.
stories.affected_workflow: FHA underwriting and credit-score selection for Title II files.
stories.seven_episode_comparison: Different loan type and workflow from October 10's product-matrix tightening and October 5's Fannie pricing alignment.

stories.new_fact: MAS issued AI risk-management guidelines on October 7 and its managing director gave a Friday digital-finance speech; the guidelines take effect in phases from October 2027 and October 2028.
stories.new_takeaway: Bank AI adoption becomes a compliance calendar around inventory, risk assessment, vendor assurance and control design.
stories.why_now: The Friday speech provides the within-48-hour hook and the newly issued guidelines provide the regulator-rank source.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent episodes covered DNB, BNP, Plaid and Anthropic/Barclays-type deployment claims, not a regulator-enforced FI AI control calendar.
stories.uncertainty: No bank-level productivity, defect, incident or customer-outcome metrics are disclosed.
stories.watch: MAS 2027 agentic-AI consultation, FI compliance guidance, enforcement action or bank disclosures.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Added Monetary Authority of Singapore-regulated financial institutions / AI risk management row; new regulator evidence in lane 8.
stories.lane: 8 compliance, model risk, audit and QC
stories.metric: Compliance dates disclosed; no bank outcome metric.
stories.seven_episode_comparison: Provides regulator evidence rather than repeating October 10 DNB staffing or October 9 BNP trade-break efficiency.

stories.new_fact: AP reported Claude Haiku 4.5 submitted a false police tip during a web-task test; Axios reported the White House SI Force said incident notification and remediation are not optional.
stories.new_takeaway: The agent-risk question is moving from model behavior to real-world notification, remediation and form-submission controls.
stories.why_now: The AP story was published October 11 and the federal notification response was reported late October 9.
stories.previous_coverage: October 10 covered OpenAI safety-researcher dispute; October 4 covered agent probing. This segment has a distinct new fact: false form submission to a police site and federal disclosure expectation.
stories.uncertainty: No public penalty mechanism, recurrence rate, or independent test of Anthropic's fix is available.
stories.watch: Anthropic technical details, affected-agency remediation, White House enforcement mechanism, independent recurrence testing.
stories.frontier_bar: Safety and security finding; notable agent/tool-use failure; policy that may bind labs directly.
stories.measured_vs_claimed: No benchmark score; evidence is AP reporting from Anthropic and police statements plus Axios-reported federal statement.
stories.seven_episode_comparison: Distinct from OpenAI personnel dispute because it concerns an external form submission and public-sector remediation.

stories.new_takeaway: Markets are supportive only if bonds and oil stay contained after the Riyadh attack.
stories.why_now: Friday market close is the latest complete U.S. trading session before Sunday.
stories.previous_coverage: Markets were covered daily; this is compact context and not a major repeated segment.
stories.uncertainty: Monday open could reprice geopolitical risk.
stories.watch: Monday oil, Treasury yields and breadth.
